extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism ontology repaired from primary XML/PDF/figure/supplement evidence; claims are live-cell probe delivery/labeling mechanisms only and do not assert antimicrobial action.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The (rR)3R2 cell-penetrating peptide component enables cytosolic delivery of otherwise cell-impermeable fluorescent probe constructs in live cells.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is cell-penetrating delivery/labeling evidence, not antimicrobial mechanism evidence.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Lifeact-bearing probes label endogenous F-actin in live cells and colocalize with standard actin markers.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Target-labeling mechanism is restricted to imaging application and does not support DRAMP antimicrobial/anticancer activity labels.
